newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 21,500 tonnes of oilseeds.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 21,500 tonnes of oilseeds.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) bought on Friday a total of 21,500 tonnes of oilseeds in tenders, an official with the federation said.
The official said the federation bought 5,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal from Toepfer and another 10,000 tonnes from Nidera.
The federation also bought 6,500 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal from LG International Corp at $166 a tonne C&F, he said.
The official said the federation was again unable to buy 8,000 tonnes of grain screening pellet as there were no offers.
The tenders were re-invited after passing last Tuesday due to high offer prices, he said.
Details for the tenders are as follows:

cottonseed meal 6,500 Oct 10 $166.00 LG Int'l Inchon
palm kernel meal 5,000 Jun 30 $99.96 Toepfer Kunsan/Ulsan

palm kernel meal 5,000 Sep 10 $97.97 Nidera Kunsan/Ulsan
